# Wiki index: dash

## Read when

- adding a command that creates, inspects or repairs the authority of a repository: [puni-dash-authority](../../libs/puni/dash/authority/src/group.ts)
- adding a command that creates, runs in, inspects or cleans up a disposable directory or worktree: [puni-dash-resources](../../libs/puni/dash/resources/src/group.ts)
- adding a command that issues a credential for the WBS MCP server: [puni-dash-mcp](../../libs/puni/dash/mcp/src/group.ts)
- adding a command that plans or runs a release of a product: [puni-dash-release](../../libs/puni/dash/release/src/group.ts)
- adding a command that records operator progress as a receipt: [puni-dash-progress](../../libs/puni/dash/progress/src/group.ts)
- adding a command that runs a command and logs the run: [puni-dash-run](../../libs/puni/dash/run/src/group.ts)
- adding a command that stores or changes the keys of an agent pool: [puni-dash-pool](../../libs/puni/dash/pool/src/group.ts)
- adding a command that submits a candidate for admission or runs its admission checks: [puni-dash-admission](../../libs/puni/dash/admission/src/group.ts)
- changing how nodes are listed, reached over SSH, or asked for their k3s cluster: [puni-dash-ops](../../libs/puni/dash/ops/src/node-shell.feature.ts)

## Commands

- `puni dash admission`: Submit candidates for admission and run their checks.
- `puni dash authority`: Create, inspect and repair the authority of a repository.
- `puni dash mcp`: Issue credentials for the WBS MCP server.
- `puni dash ops`: Reach the nodes of the inventory.
- `puni dash ops k3s`: Run kubectl on the node that runs the k3s server.
- `puni dash ops ssh`: Open a shell on a node, or run a command there.
- `puni dash pool`: Store the keys of agent pools.
- `puni dash progress`: Record operator progress as receipts.
- `puni dash release`: Plan and run releases of a product.
- `puni dash resources`: Manage disposable directories and worktrees, and the commands run in them.
- `puni dash run`: Run commands and log each run.
